policy.decision: Apply only this explicit human-reviewed representative-domain assignment for Fu Hao. Preserve any existing non-null Production value as authoritative and fail closed on conflict; perform no Role-to-Domain automation or unrelated reclassification.

review_scope.rationale: Fu Hao is represented most distinctly by securely attested military command in contemporary Shang oracle-bone and archaeological evidence. Her royal-consort status remains an important separate Activity, but military command is the stronger Person-level representative domain.
